newsitem.title: UK: Tesco market share little changed - survey.
newsitem.headline: Tesco market share little changed - survey.

text.p: The market shares of Tesco Plc and other leading UK supermarkets were little changed in the early weeks of this year compared with the last month of 1996, according to a survey by AGB Research, analysts said.
Tesco shares were up 3-1/2p at 351 by 1344 GMT.
J Sainsbury Plc's market share was 20.2 percent in the four weeks to February 9 compared with 20.1 percent in the previous survey, while Tesco dipped to 23.1 percent from 23.2 percent.
Safeway Plc edged lower to 10.9 percent from 11.3 percent and ASDA Group Plc was unchanged at 13 percent, according to the survey.
AGB does not publish the results of its monthly survey and supermarket operators themselves play down its significance but analysts say it can give a guide to underlying trends in the sector.
